whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Daniyawan Fish Dhaba,

I noticed your dhaba has strong 3.9★ reviews with over 1,150+ happy customers in Danapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct table booking and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke dhaba ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, special fish dishes showcase, aur Google Maps directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/daniyawan

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Daniyawan Fish Dhaba, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dhaba ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp takeaway ordering, fish specialty showcases, and your Gola Road location map. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur prices integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
